name: Palmachim Airbase
manufacturer: Israeli Air Force / Israel Aerospace Industries (Shavit)
best_known_for: Israel's launch site: Shavit rockets put Ofeq satellites in retrograde orbit since 1988
credit: Israeli Air Force base on the Mediterranean coast south of Tel Aviv, used jointly by the IAF and the Israel Space Agency as Israel's spaceport. Ofeq-1 on a Shavit rocket, launched on 19 September 1988, made Israel the eighth country with its own orbital launch capability. Facts from Wikipedia (Palmachim Airbase, Shavit, Ofeq) and GlobalSecurity; coordinates are Wikipedia's airbase point, not the launch pad itself.
